title: Protective effects of Ganoderma lucidum spores on estradiol benzoate-induced TEC apoptosis and compromised double-positive thymocyte development

evidence_spans.quote: Results: GLS effectively mitigates EB-induced thymic damage

scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: An original mouse study reports results on thymic atrophy explicitly framed as immune aging and states that the current study uses multi-omics techniques.

causal_design_reviewer.exposure_or_intervention: Ganoderma lucidum spores (GLS), including sporoderm-removed GLS (RGLS), in mice with estradiol benzoate-induced thymic atrophy
causal_design_reviewer.comparator: Estradiol benzoate-induced thymic-atrophy mice without GLS/RGLS treatment
causal_design_reviewer.outcome: Thymic damage and TEC apoptosis; CD4+ T-cell output; thymocyte and iNKT-cell development
causal_design_reviewer.estimand_or_contrast: Outcomes after GLS/RGLS treatment versus the EB-induced condition without GLS/RGLS, including mitigation of thymic damage and enhanced CD4+ T-cell output
